title: Synthesis — Claridad
description: A whole-board proposal: two distinct type tiers (heavy stop name, lighter destinations), a quiet grey seconds detail on the clock, boarding-now re-mapped to green so the actionable row stands apart from mere attention, and a pluralized right column label.

changes.intent: Keep the header at top weight as the heaviest text on screen.
Drop destination weight to a lighter tier below the header.

changes.detail: Add a `seconds` computed via now.value.toLocaleTimeString('es-CR', { second: '2-digit' }); keep `time` as HH:MM.

changes.intent: Render seconds as a trailing subscript.
Baseline-align so seconds can drop to a subscript.
Small, faint seconds pinned to the baseline.
ABORDANDO reads as actionable-now via the existing green live/ok token.
Match the 'ahora' eta to the same green.
Match the label to the multi-row content.
changes.detail: Change the second header span text from 'Próxima salida' to 'Próximas salidas'.
